en_title: Xbox Confirms Project Helix Is 'a Console Capable of Playing Games From Your PC'
cn_title: XBOX确认Project Helix是一款「能够运行你电脑上游戏的主机」
opus_summary: XBOX确认Project Helix旨在成为能够运行PC游戏的主机，而非能玩主机游戏的PC。次世代业务副总裁Jason Ronald表示，该项目将支持四代XBOX游戏库及进度，并为进阶用户提供设置和性能自定义选项。

paragraphs.en: Xbox has confirmed Project Helix is "designed to be a console capable of playing games from your PC."
paragraphs.cn: XBOX确认，Project Helix「被设计为一款能够运行你电脑上游戏的主机」。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft unveiled a slew of details about its past, present, and future with the surprise publication of the Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine . It's all part of surprise festivities meant to help celebrate 25 years of Xbox, and it also happens to have revealed more information about Project Helix than we've received in some time.
paragraphs.cn: 微软出人意料地发布了《XBOX 25周年纪念杂志》，披露了大量有关其过去、现在和未来的细节。这都是为庆祝XBOX诞生25周年而举办的惊喜庆典的一部分，而这本杂志恰好也透露了比我们近来所获悉的更多的Project Helix相关信息。

paragraphs.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has called the next-gen project a "family of devices" before, and although that language is used again here, vice president of next generation Jason Ronald helped paint a clearer picture. The main idea here is that, through the ups and downs of Xbox's history, many lessons have been learned.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma此前曾将这个次世代项目称为一个「设备家族」，虽然这次再次使用了这一说法，但次世代业务副总裁Jason Ronald帮助人们更清楚地了解了它。这里的主要意思是，在XBOX历史的起伏中，团队吸取了许多经验教训。

paragraphs.en: "When we think about Project Helix, it's really designed to be the ultimate gaming machine – one that removes all the barriers of play that have historically existed," Ronald said. "My entire library is accessible to me. I'm able to bring four generations of my Xbox library and progression with me and have it available instantly. And we remove the arbitrary constraints between console and PC games."
paragraphs.cn: Ronald说：「谈到Project Helix，它确实是按终极游戏设备设计的——一台能消除过去存在的所有游戏障碍的设备。我可以访问自己的整个游戏库。我能够随身带上跨越四代的XBOX游戏库和游戏进度，并立即使用。我们还消除了主机游戏和PC游戏之间人为设定的限制。」

paragraphs.en: These are already big promises for Project Helix, which has been speculated to arrive as soon as late 2027, but what actually is it? There's no telling when we'll see what the family of devices it encompasses looks like, but today, Ronald was at least willing to sell Xbox fans on the idea of a project that seems to be centered more around the traditional idea of a console than anything else.
paragraphs.cn: 对于Project Helix来说，这些承诺已经相当重大；有人猜测它最早会在2027年末推出，但它究竟是什么？目前还不知道我们何时能看到它所涵盖的设备家族究竟是什么样子，但今天，Ronald至少愿意向XBOX粉丝推介这个项目的理念：它似乎更侧重于传统意义上的主机，而非其他任何东西。

paragraphs.en: "We're very clear on the design goal: Helix is designed to be a console that is also capable of playing games from your PC. It is not a Pc that can also play console games," he added. "The goal is making it easy, intuitive, and instant to access my games. But if you're a hardcore gamer or a power user who wants to have that deeper level of customizability across settings and performance options, you can absolutely go do it."
paragraphs.cn: 他补充说：「我们的设计目标非常明确：Helix被设计为一款也能够运行你电脑上游戏的主机。它不是一台也能玩主机游戏的PC。目标是让访问我的游戏变得简单、直观且即时。但如果你是硬核玩家或高级用户，希望对设置和性能选项进行更深层次的自定义，你完全可以这么做。」

paragraphs.en: Ronald said creating the next-gen project over the years hasn't just meant answering the questions of today, though; it's meant thinking ahead, too. Without directly addressing how it may pertain to the mysterious Xbox project, Ronald pointed to how Generation Alpha adapted to a world where content isn't locked to any one device. He also touched on how he believes the barriers to creation for things like user-generated gaming content "are going to come down" in the near future, saying players will eventually "have much more agency" and "control over their experiences."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Ronald表示，多年来打造这个次世代项目并不只是回答当下的问题，也意味着要着眼未来。他没有直接说明这可能与这个神秘的XBOX项目有何关联，而是提到了阿尔法世代如何适应一个内容不被锁定在任何单一设备上的世界。他还谈到，他认为用户生成的游戏内容等事物的创作门槛在不久的将来「将会降低」，并表示玩家最终将「拥有大得多的自主权」和「对自身体验的控制权」。

paragraphs.en: The Project Helix lead also recalled how Microsoft "lost sight of what is truly magical" with the Xbox One. Going forward, it's all about the players, developers, and the games that they love.
paragraphs.cn: 这位Project Helix负责人还回顾了微软如何在XBOX One上「忽视了真正神奇的东西」。展望未来，一切都将围绕玩家、开发者以及他们热爱的游戏展开。

paragraphs.en: No matter what Project Helix is, what it can do, or what games it plays, though, one thing is more important than almost anything else: price. The gaming industry is recoiling from a component crisis that has already considerably driven up the cost of enjoying the hobby. As prices for everything from consoles to storage skyrocket, the excitement that usually permeates the atmosphere of impending next-gen upgrades has been replaced by dread. Some players have even begun asking manufacturers like Sony and Microsoft to delay new hardware plans until prices come down – or at least until they can save enough money.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，无论Project Helix是什么、它能做什么或能运行什么游戏，有一件事比几乎其他任何事情都更重要：价格。游戏行业正受到一场零部件危机的冲击，这场危机已经大幅推高了享受游戏这一爱好的成本。随着从主机到存储设备的各种产品价格飞涨，通常弥漫在次世代升级即将到来之际的兴奋情绪已被恐惧取代。一些玩家甚至开始要求索尼和微软等厂商推迟新硬件计划，直到价格下降——或者至少等到他们能攒够钱。

paragraphs.en: It's brutal out there, but Ronald is optimistic when it comes to Project Helix. He even said that the current component crisis has driven the team to meet the challenge.
paragraphs.cn: 外部形势严峻，但谈到Project Helix，Ronald仍持乐观态度。他甚至表示，当前的零部件危机促使团队迎接挑战。

paragraphs.en: "It's definitely a challenging time," he said, "but as a system and a platform designer, it's also one of the most exciting times, because we have to invent entirely new technology to continue to advance the state-of-the-art while also continuing to make things accessible and affordable.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「这无疑是一个充满挑战的时期，但作为系统和平台设计师，这也是最令人兴奋的时期之一，因为我们必须发明全新的技术，才能继续推动尖端技术的发展，同时继续让产品易于获得、价格实惠。

paragraphs.en: "This is a big reason why we're really focused on advancements like neural rendering, because it's an entirely new way to generate a frame without requiring more computational horsepower, additional memory, and things like that. I think you're going to see more innovation over the next three to five years than you've seen in the last 10 years."
paragraphs.cn: 「这是我们非常关注神经渲染等进展的一个重要原因，因为这是一种生成画面的全新方式，不需要更多计算能力、额外内存之类的东西。我认为，未来三到五年你将看到的创新会比过去10年更多。」

paragraphs.en: Microsoft believes Project Helix is a transition to the next generation of Xbox gaming consoles. To that point, Ronald said game preservation has been and will continue to be "core to Xbox." He and the team are already thinking ahead.
paragraphs.cn: 微软认为Project Helix是向下一代XBOX游戏主机的过渡。说到这一点，Ronald表示，游戏保存一直是并将继续是「XBOX的核心」。他和团队已经在着眼未来。

paragraphs.en: "[Compatibility is] really informing how we design the platform and how we work with our partners to make sure that these games can not only be played, but they can also be played better than ever before in the future," he said. "Not only are we preserving those games from the past, but it's actually informing how we're designing and building the platform and games today – so that they can be preserved 20 years, 30 years in the future."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「［兼容性］确实影响着我们如何设计平台，以及我们如何与合作伙伴协作，以确保这些游戏不仅能够运行，还能在未来获得比以往任何时候都更好的游玩体验。我们不仅在保存过去的那些游戏，这实际上还影响着我们如今如何设计和打造平台及游戏——让它们在未来20年、30年后仍能保存下来。」

paragraphs.en: Today's Xbox magazine piece also calls Project Helix the "crown jewel in a platform able to move with you." Ronald said the goal with the device is "removing barriers to play, removing friction, and those arbitrary boundaries that have existed in the past."
paragraphs.cn: 今天刊登的这篇XBOX杂志文章还将Project Helix称为「一个能够随你移动的平台上的皇冠明珠」。Ronald表示，这款设备的目标是「消除游戏障碍、消除阻碍，以及过去存在的那些人为设定的界限」。

paragraphs.en: "Our design goal is that no matter where you play," he explained, "it feels very intuitive and very distinctly 'Xbox,' but we also want to tailor it to the unique capabilities of the screen, whether that's a large-screen TV in your living room, whether you're playing on a console or you're streaming it to a small screen on a handheld device, or even on PC – where you have higher information density, you have a mouse and keyboard, you have more precision. We want it to feel very familiar, but also take advantage of the unique capabilities of the device you're actually playing on."
paragraphs.cn: 他解释说：「我们的设计目标是，无论你在哪里玩，体验都非常直观，并且具有鲜明的『XBOX』特色，但我们也希望针对屏幕的独特能力进行调整，不管那是你客厅里的大屏幕电视，不管你是在主机上玩，还是将游戏串流到掌机的小屏幕上，甚至是在PC上玩——在那里，信息密度更高，你有鼠标和键盘，操作也更精确。我们希望它给人非常熟悉的感觉，同时也能利用你实际游玩所用设备的独特能力。」

paragraphs.en: Xbox pointed to the recently released ROG Xbox Ally and Xbox mode as a tease for the direction it's heading in. The feedback it's received on the front has already helped further pave the way for Project Helix, with Ronald going as far as to say that "we view the Ally as a precursor to what we're doing with Helix – but it's informed by a lot of the design concepts we have for Helix."
paragraphs.cn: XBOX指出，最近发布的ROG XBOX Ally和XBOX模式预示了其前进的方向。它在这方面收到的反馈已经帮助Project Helix进一步铺平了道路，Ronald甚至表示：「我们将Ally视为我们正在用Helix打造的东西的先导——但它受到了我们为Helix制定的许多设计理念的影响。」

paragraphs.en: As Xbox prepares Project Helix, it's winding down a busy and tumultuous year. Sharma taking charge in the first few months of 2026 signaled that a new chapter was about to unfold, but layoffs affecting thousands and shut-down game studios have made it hard for many to look forward to what's next. Sharma admitted Microsoft's gaming brand was "not healthy" in a July update .
paragraphs.cn: 在XBOX筹备Project Helix之际，它正在结束忙碌而动荡的一年。Sharma在2026年最初几个月接掌业务，标志着新篇章即将展开，但影响数千人的裁员和关闭的游戏工作室，让许多人难以对未来抱有期待。Sharma在7月的一次情况更新中承认，微软的游戏品牌「并不健康」。

paragraphs.en: Sharma shared her vision for the next 25 years of gaming earlier this week. For more as Xbox turns 25, you can see how IGN helped celebrate the brand's big birthday. You can also check out the new nostalgic boot-up sequences added to consoles today.
paragraphs.cn: Sharma在本周早些时候分享了她对未来25年游戏发展的愿景。想了解更多XBOX迎来25周年的内容，你可以看看IGN如何帮助庆祝这一品牌的重要生日。你也可以看看今天加入主机的新怀旧启动画面。
